Compact is now the default transcription model, making the first-run choice faster and smaller.

## Highlights

- Selects Compact by default for everyday transcription, with the smallest model download and lowest storage use.
- Keeps Maximum Fidelity as the accuracy-first option and Balanced as the middle ground.
- Makes the speed, storage, and quality tradeoffs clearer in the Models panel.
- Preserves the same decoding policy used by v1.2.2 across normal and benchmark runs.

## Install

Download **Transcriber-1.2.3-macOS-arm64.zip**, unzip it, and move `Transcriber.app` to Applications.

**Requirements:** Apple Silicon and macOS 13.3 or newer.

If macOS blocks the first launch, Control-click `Transcriber.app`, choose **Open**, then confirm **Open**.

[Compare changes from v1.2.2](https://github.com/Pluze/transcriber/compare/v1.2.2...v1.2.3)
